name: Frosted Glass Lens
description: Frosted lens with a Beckmann microfacet scattering lobe — five taps drawn from a Beckmann slope distribution, giving the heavy-tailed blur of ground glass rather than a single offset — and depth-dependent frost thickness so far, cold geometry frosts over while near geometry stays clear. Adds ACES, bounded click frost-clear fronts and dataTextureC persistence, and replaces a per-frame hash grain that strobed as static with a spatially coherent drifting field.
